note: Fixed narrator lines. They never contain guests' names. audio is the file name: a Show Pack keeps it in its own audio/ folder. Without the file, the line shows as a caption only.

lines.text: The deck is shuffled, the vault is barred. Let the dealing commence!
Alas! The Vault Keeper holds twenty-one from the very first cards! The round is forfeit!
A wondrous omen! Twenty-one on the deal, and the prize is claimed!
A courageous choice! Another card is drawn from the deck of fate…
The player stands firm, trusting in their numbers.
Oh, catastrophic ruin! The total climbs too high and trouble claims the player!
The Keeper's greed becomes their undoing! The vault collapses!
Victory! The Keeper is out-witted this day.
Five cards held without a bust: a feat worthy of legend!
The Keeper smiles and bars the vault once more.
